title: On Thanking the neighbours one by one
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：thank　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thank 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the doctor ① thanked the neighbours one by one in the rain, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the doctor ② thanks the neighbours one by one without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ thank the neighbours one by one at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ thanked the neighbours one by one before — a line in the chart for January 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Thanking the neighbours one by one in the rain, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ thank everybody before leaving town without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Thank everybody before leaving town at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the chart, and a new patient from the next clinic ⑧ thanks everybody before leaving town in the rain every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ thanked the neighbours one by one again when nobody else would.

⑩ To thank the neighbours one by one, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the clinic remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the clinic forgets, somebody thanks the neighbours one by one without complaint again and somebody must thank the neighbours one by one in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 感谢（一般过去式 thanked the neighbours one by one：1972 年大夫头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 感谢（一般现在 thanks the neighbours one by one：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 感谢（不定式 to thank the neighbours one by one：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 感谢（过去完成时 had thanked the neighbours one by one：1966 年一月的病历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 感谢（动名词 thanking the neighbours one by one 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 致谢（thank everybody before leaving town：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去致谢离城前向所有人道谢）
G. v. 致谢（thank everybody before leaving town：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 感谢（后段两处：新来的病人照例 thanks everybody before leaving town，而母亲又一次 thanked the neighbours one by one）

items.q: thanked the neighbours one by one
thanks the neighbours one by one
to thank the neighbours one by one
thanked the neighbours one by one before
thanking the neighbours one by one
thank everybody before leaving town without complaint
thank everybody before leaving town at once
thanks everybody before leaving town in the rain
thanked the neighbours one by one again
to thank the neighbours one by one

answers.why: thank 意为“感谢”，1972 年大夫淋着雨感谢一家家去谢过邻居，那是卫生所里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 thanked。
thank 意为“感谢”，自那以后大夫毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 thanks。
thank 意为“感谢”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯感谢一家家去谢过邻居”，此处为不定式 to thank the neighbours one by one。
thank 意为“感谢”，病历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1979 年之前就有人感谢过，故用过去完成时 had thanked。
thank 意为“感谢”，大夫说“感谢一家家去谢过邻居这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 thanking the neighbours one by one 作主语。
thank 意为“致谢”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去致谢离城前向所有人道谢”，should ever 之后用原形 thank everybody before leaving town。
thank 意为“致谢”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻致谢离城前向所有人道谢（thank everybody before leaving town at once），以后再也不要提起。
thank 意为“感谢”，新来的病人每个星期都照例致谢离城前向所有人道谢，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 thanks。
thank 意为“感谢”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨感谢一家家去谢过邻居，用一般过去式 thanked 叙述。
thank 意为“感谢”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要感谢一家家去谢过邻居，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和卫生所记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，大夫淋着雨感谢一家家去谢过邻居；卫生所里每一个病人都说这是头一回。（thanked the neighbours one by one）
多年以后，大夫仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（thanks the neighbours one by one）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯感谢一家家去谢过邻居这件事本身。（to thank the neighbours one by one）
早在 1966 年就有人感谢一家家去谢过邻居，一月那天病历上的一行字就是证据。（had thanked the neighbours one by one）
大夫说过，淋着雨感谢一家家去谢过邻居这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（thanking the neighbours one by one 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻致谢离城前向所有人道谢，以后再也不要提起。（thank everybody before leaving town，祈使句）
answers: In 1972 the doctor thanked the neighbours one by one in the rain, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the doctor still thanks the neighbours one by one without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to thank the neighbours one by one at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had thanked the neighbours one by one long before 1979, and the line in the chart for January proves it.
Thanking the neighbours one by one in the rain, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Thank everybody before leaving town at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 thank 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the doctor thanked the neighbours one by one in the rain, and nobody in the clinic forgot it.
Even now the doctor thanks the neighbours one by one without complaint whenever the clinic asks.
Thanking the neighbours one by one in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever thank everybody before leaving town without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new patient from the next clinic thanks everybody before leaving town in the rain every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother thanked the neighbours one by one again, and the clinic remembered that half.
